A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same FASB research, including the main text, Appendices A–K, and NeurIPS checklist. The text, equations, figures, and tables are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original FASB evaluations on TruthfulQA and other benchmarks, with quantitative comparisons, ablations, and supplementary experiments in Tables 1–13.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the Probe and Prototype evaluations, generalization experiments, and appendix sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3, Appendix A, and Algorithm 1 retain the same Probe/Prototype constructions, head selection, deviation tracking, adaptive intervention strength, and backtracking procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate TruthfulQA, COPA, StoryCloze, NLI, MMLU, SST2, Winogrande, Natural Questions, TriviaQA, WikiHop, and RealToxicityPrompts. The represented tasks and test scenarios are unchanged, including appendix coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments. Table 1 retains the unsteered baseline, ITI, CAA, ORTHO, CAST, ACT, and SADI-HEAD; Table 2 retains its original comparator set. Appendix comparisons, including BTB and GCBB in Table 7, are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, tested LLMs and sizes, hyperparameter searches, head counts, backtracking settings, and training-size experiments remain identical across Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both retain Table 3's intervention-strength and intervention-position ablations, transfer evaluations, and sensitivity analyses in Figures 6–8 and Tables 12–13. Appendix analyses of regeneration variants, TruthfulQA categories, and deviation positions also match.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 states in both versions that results were obtained through cross-validation over two runs. There are no changes to run-count disclosures, seed information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains Probe scores of 80.56% True*Info, 48.71% MC1, and 66.58% MC2; Table 5 retains Prototype's 83.94% True*Info.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7) and their definitions are unchanged, including deviation probability, adaptive steering strength, and prototype construction. Neither version contains formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about dynamically determining intervention necessity and strength, correcting deviations through backtracking, and outperforming comparison methods.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are retained. Appendix K preserves the same limitations concerning misuse, hyperparameter dependence, English QA coverage, and errors from LLM-based evaluators.

D1.justification: Implementation details in Section 4.1 and Appendix A, Algorithm 1, and the disclosure of four NVIDIA A800 GPUs are unchanged. Both versions retain the same repository link and future code/data release statements.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to prior activation-steering methods are unchanged. The updated publication footer does not alter the research's claimed relationship to earlier work.

P1.justification: v2 reverses the order of Jinwei Gan and Zifeng Cheng, updates email addresses, adds Zhiwei Jiang's corresponding-author designation, and replaces the preprint footer with NeurIPS 2025 information. The body wording and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is smaller in v2, with a narrower caption and corresponding reflow of the introduction across pages 1–2. Other changes are minor typographic spacing; figure and table contents, numbering, and placements are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 updates authorship/contact information and publication labeling and adjusts the first-page layout. The method, empirical evidence, interpretations, limitations, and reproducibility disclosures remain unchanged. These localized administrative and presentation edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
